Same round bulb, stopper, band, liquid levels, glass thickness and cord attachment in every view; rear reverses cord position. No combined 3-4/ICON. Hidden closure and cord depth inferred.
Realistic slightly worn clear dark glass, non-glowing colored liquids, aged brass and simple stopper. Opaque charcoal-gray background, soft neutral WHITE studio light, no colored lighting, bloom, fantasy aura or dramatic shadow. Labels only ARENA POTION / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON. No hands, character, scenery, extra bottles or watermark. Never paste, trace or display private sprite pixels; ICON newly rendered HD from this same candidate.

Glass depth, stopper material, metal collars, cord attachment and rear are conservative inference.
